driver: A suspected effect of starting a treatment is tested by comparing the people who start it with people who do not, but the people who start it are chosen for a reason that already carries the outcome, a trait no recorded variable captures, so the comparison, adjusted for everything recorded, names the treatment its users were already at risk under; only comparing each person's outcomes in the window just after starting with the same person's other time, which cancels every fixed trait, finds the treatment that changes the outcome.
driver_concrete: Three signals came out of the quarter's spontaneous reports: falls with a new orexin-receptor sleep medicine, acute kidney injury with a new uricosuric for gout, and pancreatitis with a new weight-loss medicine. The sleep medicine is marketed as gentler for older people and is channelled to frail patients already falling, and the uricosuric, avoided in kidney disease, is channelled to gout patients with healthy kidneys, so both the matched non-user comparison and the new-user active-comparator design (against zopiclone and allopurinol starters) put the sleep medicine first; within each patient the 30 days after starting carry no more falls than the same patient's later time on it, while the uricosuric's first 30 days carry about two and a half times the same patients' kidney injury rate.
stump: A competent solver links the prescription and patient registries, takes each medicine's new users, compares their admissions for the signalled event in the 30 days after starting with matched non-users and then with new users of the established alternative (zopiclone, allopurinol, orlistat), adjusts for every recorded comorbidity and names the sleep medicine's falls signal, the largest ratio on both designs; the step that lands it there is comparing people with other people, when the sleep medicine is channelled to patients already falling and the uricosuric to patients with healthy kidneys, and only the self-controlled comparison of each patient's first 30 days with the same patient's later time confirms the uricosuric's kidney injury signal instead.

lineage.driver: A monitored signal that the standard reads as the unit's own fault can be carried in from an attached compartment whose ordinary operation produces it, so ranking units on the signal measured in the main body puts units with a leaking neighbour ahead of units with genuine internal faults; only attributing each unit's signal to its source, by its co-movement with the neighbour's operations and its composition, separates them.

notes: Re-root of task180 (architecture 3, the slot's last). v2 spent at judge pass 2 (SEND_BACK): its hardening put the decisive signal at the noise floor of a second lens; this draw keeps the decisive separation far above the noise of every lens a reviewer can bring (the self-controlled incidence rate ratios asserted on a grid of risk windows, age bands, observation periods and pre-exposure windows). Exposure comes from first dispensings only (a 30-day risk window from the first dispensing of a new user), so no exposure duration or overlapping-fill construction sits in this build. The committee's question (is the medicine causing the event in the month after it is started) is the prompt's; the agency's signal procedure files the case definitions and the new-user rule, never the comparison design. No calibration corpus, no filed decoy: the spontaneous-report line listing is correct and labelled as reports. layer1: hospital diagnoses in the national patient registry coded ICD-10 with the registry's D prefix, as action and secondary diagnoses on contacts, with transfers between departments as separate contacts of one admission
the patient registry's 2019 change from courses to contacts, so pre-2019 and post-2019 records have different structures
prescription registry dispensings coded by ATC with package size and defined daily doses, with ATC codes reassigned for one product
pseudonymised personal identification numbers across registries, with deaths and emigrations in the civil registration extract ending observation
spontaneous reports with suspect and concomitant medicines, follow-up versions of one case and MedDRA terms
analyst_test: A strong analyst who links the registries correctly, restricts to new users and compares the 30-day admission rate after starting each medicine with matched non-users and then with new users of the established alternative, adjusted for every recorded comorbidity, confirms the sleep medicine's falls signal, because the new medicine is channelled to frail patients already falling and the uricosuric to patients with healthy kidneys; only the within-patient comparison of the first 30 days with the same patient's later time confirms the uricosuric's kidney injury signal.
domain_test: The decisive analysis is the self-controlled case series pharmacoepidemiology uses to test an acute adverse reaction in registry data, each patient's events in the risk window after starting the medicine against the same patient's other time; swapped into a field without individual exposure start dates, acute risk windows and repeated events on the same person, the design and the question disappear.
